info.title: Change Restricted Course Last Start Date API
info.description: API for managing the last start date for restricted courses linked to providers.

get.summary: Get the change restricted course last start date view

parameters.name: larsCode
parameters.description: The LARS code identifying the restricted course.

200.description: Successful response with the view model details.

302.description: Redirect to route with provider apprenticeships.

404.description: Not found if the session is invalid or course is not valid for last start date change.

post.summary: Set a new last start date for the restricted course

parameters.name: larsCode
parameters.description: The LARS code identifying the restricted course.

requestBody.description: The details to submit the new last start date.

200.description: Successful response after updating the last start date.

302.description: Redirect to route with provider apprenticeships.

400.description: Validation error response if the submitted model is invalid.

Day.description: The day part of the date.

Month.description: The month part of the date.

Year.description: The year part of the date.

LarsCode.description: The LARS code identifying the course.

CourseLastDateStarts.description: The current last start date for the course.
